note: Identical camera records are reused byte-for-byte by the baseline and variant captures. Positions are authored inspection viewpoints in uncalibrated design units; the camera is the InspectionCamera of each instantiated scene. translate_a and translate_b are separated along X with the SAME look direction (target minus position is [0,0,-10] for both); rotated holds the translate_a position but changes orientation in place; seam_check is a slightly elevated oblique diagnostic. The movement sequence walks the bounded path in five recorded steps. on_path=false marks the elevated seam diagnostic, which is exempt from the ground path bounds.

views.description: left end of bounded path, looking -Z
right end of bounded path, identical orientation to translate_a
slightly elevated diagnostic for seam, clipping and occlusion inspection; off the bounded inspection path

movement_sequence.note: Short bounded translation from translate_a to translate_b at fixed height and orientation; recorded transforms are written to the capture manifest.
